name: Doctor Dustless LLC
what_they_do: Owner-operated hardwood floor company doing dustless sanding and refinishing, floor repairs and new wood floor installation across central New Jersey. Site states over 20 years of experience, LLC licence #13VH04420900 and 'fully insured'.
customers: Homeowners in central New Jersey renovating or restoring wood floors (whole-home refinishing, repairs after damage, new installs).

size_signals.signal: 'Owner operated company with over 20 years of experience'; LLC licence #13VH04420900 and 'Fully Insured' in the footer
Service area limited to 'Central New Jersey'; hours Mon-Fri 08:00-20:00 with Saturday and Sunday blank
5.0 from 58 reviews on Angi and 5.0 from 72 on Porch

listing.platform: Angi / HomeAdvisor (5.0 from 58 reviews); Porch also 5.0 from 72

website_review.primary_cta: Phone number at the top of the page (click-to-call) and a 'Let's Talk! / Leave details' pop-up on mobile
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact-page form with First Name, Last Name, Email, Subject and Message - no phone field, no address/square-footage fields, no scheduler, and the form is reCAPTCHA-protected
website_review.trust_signals: Licence number and 'fully insured' in the footer, gallery of finished floors, testimonials page, 'Our Promise' copy, 20+ years, care-tips content
website_review.out_of_date_signs: GoDaddy-builder layout with image-based logo and a 'Share by:' social bar; the mobile header leaves a tall empty black band and the top nav overflows the screen; the tel: link sits at x=444 on a 390px viewport, i.e. pushed off-screen, so the phone number is not visible or tappable on a phone
website_review.search_basics: Titles include the town ('Home - Spotswood NJ - Doctor Dustless', 'Contact Us - Spotswood NJ'); meta description names floor refinishing, Spotswood and the phone; but there is only one service page structure (home + about + care tips + gallery + testimonials + contact) with no dedicated pages for refinishing, repair or installation, and no schema at all
top_issues: Zero structured data: no LocalBusiness JSON-LD, so address, hours, licence and service area are invisible to agents
Mobile header is broken: phone link positioned off-screen (x=444 at 390px width) and nav items clipped, so there is no working click-to-call on a phone
Contact form omits the phone number and job details (square footage, floor type), and sits behind reCAPTCHA - a poor quote-request path for a job that is priced by area
No dedicated service pages, no prices or per-square-foot ranges, and no online estimate booking
Saturday/Sunday hours are left blank rather than stated as closed

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt is fully open (only a sitemap line) so OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot are allowed; sitemap.xml present; strong third-party review presence (5.0 on Angi and Porch). Answerable: the contact page carries address, phone, email, 'Central New Jersey' service area and Mon-Fri 8am-8pm hours as text, but none of it is in schema, there are no price ranges, and the only service description is generic prose. Bookable: the contact form is reCAPTCHA-gated, has no phone field and no scheduling, and on mobile the click-to-call link is pushed off-screen - an agent has effectively no path to a quote.

operations_signals.signal: Every job is priced from a phone conversation or a form that lacks square footage/floor type, so each estimate needs a callback and often a site visit
Owner-operated with 12-hour weekday availability and no weekend hours - calls during jobs go unanswered with no capture path
One Angi reviewer noted late/rescheduled starts even while praising the work (summarised), a scheduling-communication symptom

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile header and make click-to-call work, then add a proper estimate form (name, phone, address, square footage, floor type, photo upload) without CAPTCHA
top_opportunities.evidence: Phone link sits at x=444 on a 390px viewport (off-screen), nav overflows, contact form has no phone or job-detail fields and is reCAPTCHA-protected

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD plus separate refinishing / repair / installation pages with per-square-foot price ranges
top_opportunities.evidence: No ld+json blocks anywhere; single generic service description; no prices published

top_opportunities.opportunity: Quote-intake agent that asks square footage, floor type and timing, gives a ballpark range, books an on-site measure, and sends reminders
top_opportunities.evidence: Pricing is per-job by phone, the form collects no job details, and hours are Mon-Fri only for a one-person operation

scores.reasons: Gap: no schema, broken mobile click-to-call, weak quote form, no service pages - several quick fixes. Pay: owner-operated floor refinishing, a $2k-$8k ticket per home, so a few extra jobs pay for the work. Ease: a six-page builder site with no integrations, so fixes are contained. Evidence: mobile positioning bug and form fields measured directly in the browser, licence and hours read from the site, reviews from Angi.
